visual_evaluation.method: Direct visual inspection of all six 384x384 EEVEE PNGs; technical reports reviewed separately.

scale.1: Requirement absent or major visual problems

proportions.notes: Compact seat and leg proportions remain clear; dimensions are separately validated.

silhouette.notes: Symmetric splayed legs and tapered shape remain visible; cardinal views overlap pairs of legs.

structural_plausibility.notes: Legs meet the seat with no joinery or bracing shown; approximate checks do not certify strength.

surface_cleanliness.notes: No visible holes or detached parts. Faceted legs, uneven highlights and noisy shadows beneath the seat are visible.

material_plausibility.notes: Warm brown opaque PBR reads as a basic wood-colored surface. Uniform color has no grain or texture; highlights and noisy shadows limit realism.

limitations: Self-review, not independent or blind evaluation.
Uniform PBR parameters do not supply wood grain.
Physical stability and exact surface contact are not certified.
Previous agent evidence is retained as a pre-material baseline, not rerun.
